services.value: Provides environmental compliance services including environmental consulting, compliance services (including LDAR compliance and auditing/management, EHS program management, health & safety consulting and training, and risk assessments/mitigation planning), assessment & remediation (Phase I & II Environmental Site Assessments and remediation of contamination), on-site testing & monitoring, source testing (stack testing/CEMS/Temp CEMS, engine testing, RNG, fugitive emissions, ambient air, LDAR, OGI, SkyBridge), and laboratory testing & analysis (environmental oil & gas lab services and environmental lab services).
